ValidationRule.description: Only the assigned approver, a user with PKR Approve Any, or a PKR admin can approve or reject.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending")), $User.Id <> Approver__c, NOT($Permission.PKR_Approve_Any), NOT($Permission.PKR_Deploy_Products) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the assigned approver (or a user allowed to approve any approval) can approve or reject this approval.
